title: MrLTTec Control {version} is here
caption: Run the whole room from your iPhone: lights, TV, music and the gaming PC, on your home Wi-Fi or anywhere over Tailscale.
changes: Fast TV buttons: at home, remote buttons, apps and typing go straight from your phone to the TV (turn on in Settings, press OK on the TV once)
Big Now Playing page: drag the progress bar, shuffle, repeat, volume and Up Next
New Music tab: search all your songs, MrLTTec Favorites / Brazileroas / All songs, Shuffle, cover art
New TV remote with power and input, plus YouTube, MrLTTec Music, Live TV and MovieBox buttons
Tap the Gaming PC card for its stats and to launch Steam, Fortnite, Minecraft or Discord
Phone volume buttons change the TV volume (Settings)
Faster buttons: the screen changes right away
